dataAndProviderLimits: A synthetic one-page PDF and intentionally public guest links were used; owner authentication and both guest session types were real. No API, authentication, database or storage response was mocked.
The HTTP server ran the production bundle with local integration disabled; the fixture driver separately required development plus explicit local integration mode and loopback services.
The evidence covers current-primary publication and scoped sharing requests, not every file format, every role/state, production providers, deployment, or comprehensive security certification.

Previously issued page/original URLs retain their lifetime: two-minute default and one-hour cap on the tested getFile endpoint. Other signing paths have separate lifetimes; delivered bytes cannot be withdrawn.
cleanup: Both the retained replay and fresh verification removed only their own fixture IDs/object keys and guest-state files. Original core owner membership, room and links were not mutated.
